decision.title: Item and sequence representation
decision.summary: sxml_item and sxml_sequence are 16-byte plain values with private fields, small values inline and others in cells, and a sequence is empty, one inline item, or a vector, range, concatenation or lazy cell.

body.p: (task 0.7). sxml_item and sxml_sequence are 16-byte plain values with private fields; the size is frozen as ABI (static assert). Inline: booleans, doubles, floats, integers that fit int64_t (any integer type), QName/NOTATION (name identifier + prefix identifier), node references (tree pointer + node index + namespace number). Cells: strings, decimals, big integers, dates, durations, binary, function items, maps, arrays, JNodes. A sequence is the empty sequence (all zero), one inline item (an item is a singleton sequence, XDM 4.0, section 3.2), or a cell: vector, integer range (two int64_t bounds), concatenation (flattened parts), or lazy (a sxml_sequence_generator, memoized so every reading sees the same items). One read interface serves all: count, get item by index, iterator. Item counts and indices in sequences are uint64_t, since 1 to 10000000000 is valid on 32-bit WebAssembly; counts of things held in memory are size_t.
